rawText: CHÂTEAU DE FLANDRY | CHARDONNAY LIMOUX | APPELLATION D'ORIGINE CONTRÔLÉE | 2023
description: Limoux AOC is a Languedoc appellation in the Aude department known for producing still Chardonnay-based white wines, distinct from the sparkling Blanquette and Crémant de Limoux made in the same zone. The appellation permits Chardonnay, often blended with a small proportion of Mauzac and Chenin Blanc, though many estates bottle a varietal Chardonnay. Vineyards lie on limestone and clay soils in the foothills of the Pyrenees, benefiting from a cooler mesoclimate favorable to Chardonnay ripening.
